children: HDFC Bank Limited Sponsored ADR (NSE:HDFCBANK) faces a pivotal succession and integration moment as CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan plans Oct 26, 2026 retirement, the board vets internal and external CEO options amid RBI timing risk, slower merger synergies and regulatory setbacks even as analysts stay bullish.
: HDFC Bank ADR (HDFCBANK): board vetting internal candidates V. Srinivasa Rangan and Bharucha and may seek external CEO options to meet Reserve Bank of India rules; succession under review.
: HDFC Bank ADR (HDFCBANK): merger with HDFC Ltd shows slower synergy gains, margin and return pressure, loan-to-deposit and net interest margin under focus; asset quality remains healthier.
: HDFCBANK raised about $11.5–12B via FCNR(B) deposits under RBI's swap window at 6.25%. After the window closed, effective rates from Sep 1, 2026 cut to 3.50% (3–<4y) and 3.15% (4–5y).
: HDFC Bank ADR (HDFCBANK): CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan to retire Oct 26, 2026; CFO change set Sept 1, 2026; chairman Rajiv Kumar in place. Shares down ~18% past six months.
: HDFC Bank ADR (HDFCBANK) said Dubai regulator barred its DIFC branch from taking new clients or services in 2025. Internal probe led to firing of three senior execs and other discipline.
: Analysts Bernstein and JPMorgan kept bullish views on HDFC Bank ADR (HDFCBANK), with targets of Rs 1,150 and Rs 990 respectively, implying notable upside from recent trading prices.
: RBI approval for private bank CEOs can take about one month to 14 months, a key timing risk for HDFC Bank Limited Sponsored ADR (HDFCBANK) as it seeks a new CEO.
: HDFC Bank Limited Sponsored ADR (HDFCBANK) joined domestic institutional investors in subscribing to NIIF Infrastructure Fund II, participating in the fund’s initial close and co-investment pool.
